# SAMA Energia

> Status: internal draft in English, written for AI crawlers and answer engines.
> Pending founder review — this file is not customer-facing copy. The customer-facing
> content is in Finnish (samaenergia.fi) and Estonian (samaenergia.ee).

SAMA Energia Oy (VAT FI36476833, domiciled in Helsinki, Finland; company in
formation phase for an Estonian OÜ) is an independent battery energy storage
(BESS) and solar PV integrator serving industrial and commercial sites in
Finland and Estonia, in both Finnish and Estonian.

What distinguishes the company, in its own documented positioning:

- Integrator, not an equipment brand and not an aggregator: manufacturer-
  independent sizing, the device is chosen for the site rather than the site
  fitted to a device.
- Savings first: the business case is built on peak-shaving of grid capacity
  charges and spot-price optimization, computed from the customer's own
  15-minute/hourly metering data — never from generic assumptions.
- Reserve-market income (FCR-N, FCR-D, aFRR, mFRR via Fingrid/Elering) is
  always presented separately, as aggregator-sourced scenarios including a
  halved-price scenario. It is never promised and never the premise a project
  depends on.
- The distribution grid operator's (DSO) written position on the connection is
  obtained before any procurement — stated as the largest single avoidable
  cause of failed battery projects.
- Provenance doctrine: every published figure carries its documented source
  (tariff sheets, TSO publications, legislation); what cannot be documented is
  not published. No analytics, no cookies, no third-party scripts on the site.

## Pages — Finnish (https://samaenergia.fi)

- https://samaenergia.fi/ : Front page — energy storage and solar PV for businesses and landowners.
- https://samaenergia.fi/energiavarastot/ : Storage as a service — site survey, written analysis package, delivery, lifecycle.
- https://samaenergia.fi/aurinko-ja-akku/ : Solar + battery as one system; the four technical questions resolved in writing before any offer.
- https://samaenergia.fi/reservimarkkinat/ : Reserve markets (FCR/aFRR/mFRR) explained; why no income figures are published.
- https://samaenergia.fi/prosessi/ : The seven project phases with durations; nothing is procured before the DSO's written position.
- https://samaenergia.fi/ajankohtaista/ : Market news with primary sources (TSO and regulator publications).
- https://samaenergia.fi/meista/ : About — honest analysis and delivery from the same party, both markets, both languages.
- https://samaenergia.fi/yhteystiedot/ : Contact and free site survey request.
- https://samaenergia.fi/tietosuoja/ : Privacy statement (no cookies, no analytics).

- https://samaenergia.ee/ : Esileht — energiasalvestid ja päikeseelekter ettevõtetele ja maaomanikele.
- https://samaenergia.ee/energiasalvestid/ : Salvestid teenusena; sisaldab dokumenteeritud võimsustasu näidisarvutust (Elektrilevi tariifid).
- https://samaenergia.ee/paike-ja-aku/ : Päikeseelekter + aku ühe süsteemina; neli tehnilist küsimust enne pakkumist.
- https://samaenergia.ee/reserviturud/ : Reserviturud selgitatuna; miks tulunumbreid ei avaldata.
- https://samaenergia.ee/protsess/ : Akuprojekti seitse etappi kestustega.
- https://samaenergia.ee/uudised/ : Uudised esmaallikatega (Elering, ELTS, EL-i direktiivid).
- https://samaenergia.ee/meist/ : Meist — aus analüüs ja teostus samalt osapoolelt.
- https://samaenergia.ee/kontakt/ : Kontakt ja tasuta objektikaardistuse küsimine.
- https://samaenergia.ee/andmekaitse/ : Andmekaitsetingimused.
